instructions: Examples are intentionally empty. Collect at least 10 independently human-annotated profiles; never copy model outputs as ground truth.

Each example needs id, structured profile, relevant_ids (actual company IDs or FDA K-numbers), candidate_kind (all/company/fda_510k_record), reviewed_by, reviewed_on (YYYY-MM-DD), and annotation_notes.
Optionally add expected_fields mapping profile field names to independently human-checked literal strings or null for simple extraction-field accuracy.
Freeze the local company/FDA corpus and document relevance criteria before evaluation. Keep private profile/annotation files local.
An explicit empty relevant_ids list is allowed for a human-reviewed negative case; recall is undefined, not a fabricated zero or perfect score.
Citation validity is a structural/quote check, not proof of semantic entailment or clinical equivalence.
